method: Website and source review; no installation, render test, purchase, or exhaustive review of every gallery item.

deferred.name: Launch Video Template Pack
deferred.reason: Paid template pack found on the project website. Preview reviewed; purchased files, per-template source, and exact reuse terms were not inspected. Do not classify the pack as open source.

deferred.name: OpenDesign Template Catalog
deferred.reason: Mixed catalog includes video styles, prompt-only entries, and apparent HyperFrames counterparts. Select an individual downloadable artifact and resolve its original author/source before admission.

deferred.name: Anatomy Message Queue
deferred.reason: Promising marble-run system explainer. Website and import guidance reviewed; verify the figure package source, license, and deterministic video integration before admission.

deferred.name: ThreeUI Particle Wordmark
deferred.reason: Particle typography useful for title sequences. Website/source context found, but item-specific access terms and a controlled video timeline still need verification.

deferred.name: Skillry Pencil-to-Light Loop
deferred.reason: Detailed looping-video prompt and original-post attribution found. No executable scene inspected; keep as a prompt lead rather than a ready-made video template.

deferred.name: Anatomy Community Figures
deferred.reason: Community examples are promising; review each author's source and asset permissions independently before importing a specific figure.

deferred.name: Manim Example Gallery
deferred.reason: Official examples expose Python implementations. Select specific scenes and document adaptation requirements before adding entries; the framework is already listed.
